files.sha256: windowed run; full-corpus hash carried by the primary replay result

parameters.cooccurrence_approximation: the co-occurrence verdict is dropped in held-out eras when its minimising pair touches the held-out field; the graph itself still contains the field's nodes, an approximation recorded here
parameters.mi_estimator: maximum pairwise empirical MI (nats) against retained categorical fields, on a deterministic 1-in-16 event sample
parameters.treatment_c: NOT RUN: mask embedding and borrowing requires a mask-similarity model; a shallow version degrades to treatment A without reporting it (§11.2), which would be worse than declaring the treatment unimplemented
